# Support-ticket RAG assistant

**Client:** a SaaS company (synthetic).

## Problem
The client needed a chatbot that answers questions from our internal documents and had no in-house capacity.

## What I did
I built the solution with RAG, langchain, FAISS, fast api. The work also involved scripting and automation.

## Result
The project cut first-response time from 9 hours to 40 minutes.

arguments.cover_letter:
You need a document Q&A chatbot for your healthcare business, and the projects below are the closest matches from my portfolio.

On Support-ticket RAG assistant for a SaaS client I used RAG, LangChain, FAISS and cut first-response time from 9 hours to 40 minutes.

On Contract question-answering bot for a real estate client I used RAG, LangChain, LLM fine-tuning and answered 86% of test questions with a correct citation.

On Fine-tuned support tone model for an e-commerce client I used LLM fine-tuning, PyTorch, Python and lifted agent acceptance of drafts from 41% to 73%.

I have also worked with FastAPI on other client projects.

I can start this week. Would a 20 minute call suit you to confirm scope and milestones?
screening_answers: The closest match is Support-ticket RAG assistant, where I cut first-response time from 9 hours to 40 minutes.
